name: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、主要按鈕右，沒有導覽連結
desc: 沒有底板的整列頁首，固定在頂端；只有標誌（旁邊可放次要文字）和一顆主要按鈕，沒有導覽連結和選單按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端。頁首沒有底板，標誌與主要按鈕各自直接放在頁面上。標誌在左，功能區靠右，所有元素垂直置中排成一列；頁首沒有導覽連結，也沒有選單按鈕。標誌右側可放一段次要文字，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。功能區放一個主要按鈕，按鈕明顯比標誌醒目。標誌與按鈕分別靠近畫面左右邊緣，只保留少量邊距，比頁面內容寬度更寬。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：標誌與次要文字在左、主要按鈕在右排成一列，同樣沒有底板，沒有導覽連結也沒有選單按鈕，元素仍靠近畫面左右邊緣。頁首全程固定在畫面頂端，捲動後不改變。

en.name: Bare header bar with logo left and primary button right, no navigation
en.desc: A full-width header with no backing panel, fixed to the top; it holds only the logo (with optional secondary text beside it) and one primary button, with no navigation links and no menu button.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header has no backing panel; the logo and the primary button sit directly on the page. Place the logo on the left and the actions group on the right, all vertically centered in one row; the header has no navigation links and no menu button. Optionally place a short secondary text to the right of the logo; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. The actions group holds one primary button, clearly more prominent than the logo. The logo and the button sit close to the left and right edges of the viewport with only a small margin, wider than the page content width.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: the logo and secondary text on the left and the primary button on the right in one row, still with no backing panel, no navigation links and no menu button, with the elements still close to the left and right edges of the viewport. The header stays fixed to the top of the viewport throughout and does not change on scroll.
